description: This is a unit test source file for the BasketService component within the application. It includes tests for transferring baskets, handling anonymous and registered user baskets, and interactions with the basket repository.

classes.name: TransferBasket
classes.description: A test class containing various unit tests for the BasketService's basket transfer functionality.

methods.name: InvokesBasketRepositoryFirstOrDefaultAsyncOnceIfAnonymousBasketNotExists
methods.description: Tests that the repository's FirstOrDefaultAsync method is called exactly once when the anonymous basket does not exist.

methods.name: TransferAnonymousBasketItemsWhilePreservingExistingUserBasketItems
methods.description: Verifies that items from an anonymous basket are transferred to an existing user basket while preserving existing items.

methods.name: RemovesAnonymousBasketAfterUpdatingUserBasket
methods.description: Ensures that the anonymous basket is deleted after its items are transferred and the user basket is updated.

methods.name: CreatesNewUserBasketIfNotExists
methods.description: Tests that a new basket is created if the user does not have an existing basket when transferring from an anonymous basket.
